::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** February 26, 1854.  
**From:** [Otterbourne]  
**Manuscript:** MS location unknown.  Printed in Coleridge, <i>[Life](other_books/otherbook_40.qmd)</i> 195.
:::

My trouble has come; he had a second attack and died at six to-night.

[Mamma](people/person_1606.qmd) is too like [Amy](cmy_books/cmybook_15.qmd), excited with thankfulness. I dread what it will be; I don't think we half believe it yet.

You will write to me; perhaps I may write to-morrow, but I can't tell. We have [Mr](people/person_798.qmd). and [Mrs. Keble](people/person_795.qmd) helping us to-night. Oh what will the waking be! So many of our Psalm superstitions have come true.

Your most affectionate 
C. M. Y.
